name: Brenske's Blueberries
tagline: From cancer to cultivation: BK Blueberries is a labor of love and healing
description: Brenske's Blueberries is an agritourism farm in 505 Roosevelt Rd, MI, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
